title: ¿Qué onda, {sibling}?
subtitle: Chatting with {sibling}
scene: {sibling}, {partner}’s sibling, sits down next to you. With {sibling}, tú is perfect.

lines.note: With siblings and cousins your age, use tú.

lines.es: Bien, bien. Oye, ¿te gusta la música?
lines.en: Good, good. Hey, do you like music?
lines.note: Oye = hey, listen (tú). Used to start a new topic.

lines.en: Yes, a lot. What music do you like?
I love cumbia. Do you dance?

lines.note: No pasa nada = no problem, it’s fine. Very common in Mexico.
¡Órale! and va are casual and very Mexican. Great with {sibling}, not with the parents.
